title: Switchboard: AI change workflows on AWS
description: A Python and LangGraph AI system on AWS that investigates customer changes, requires independent human approval, and verifies delivery after execution.
seoTitle: Switchboard | AI Change Workflows on AWS | Hanif Carroll
seoDescription: A Python and LangGraph AI change-management system using AWS Lambda, Step Functions, SQS, DynamoDB, and CloudFormation, with independent approval and verified delivery.
role: Workflow design, backend and agent engineering, frontend, and deployment
problem: Investigating a change request requires checking business records and policies, but a plausible AI answer is not enough authority to change a production configuration.
solution: Built read-only, access-controlled investigation tools and validated source-backed reports before saving proposals.
Orchestrated investigation, independent approval, execution, and delivery verification with Step Functions, SQS, and DynamoDB transactions.
Defined infrastructure with CloudFormation and automated deployments through GitHub Actions using OIDC, with CloudWatch monitoring and distributed tracing.
result: A public AWS deployment using synthetic customer data, verified with live-model investigations, independent approval, signed HTTP delivery, and retry and isolation checks.
